prompt:
Generate a Vastu-compliant 2BHK home layout for a 25x35 feet plot.

Room requirements:
- Living Room in the North-East (12x14 ft)
- Kitchen in the South-East (8x10 ft)
- Master Bedroom in the South-West (13x15 ft)
- Bedroom in the North-West (10x12 ft)
- Common Toilet in the North (6x6 ft)
- Pooja Room in the East (4x4 ft)

Return the layout as a JSON array with each room defined by:
- name
- x (starting x-coordinate)
- y (starting y-coordinate)
- width (in feet)
- height (in feet)
Only return the JSON array. Do not include any explanation or text.

Generate a Vastu-compliant 3BHK layout for a 30x40 feet rectangular plot.

Required room placement:
- Master Bedroom (14x14) in South-West
- Children Bedroom (12x12) in North-West
- Guest Bedroom (12x13) in South-East
- Living Room (16x14) in North-East
- Kitchen (10x8) in East
- Common Toilet (6x6) in North
- Pooja Room (4x4) in East

Output only a JSON array of rooms with name, x, y, width, height.

Design a Vastu-compliant 1BHK layout on a compact 20x30 feet plot.

Place:
- Living Room (12x12) in NE
- Bedroom (12x12) in SW
- Kitchen (8x6) in SE
- Toilet (6x6) in N
- Pooja Room (3x4) in E

Return only a JSON array with fields: name, x, y, width, height.
